items.title: continue 与 proceed 的后接结构
items.explanation: continue doing 与 continue to do 通常都表示继续做某事；continue with 后接名词。proceed to 后接地点或动词原形，proceed with 后接事情或计划。
items.source: continue doing, continue to do, continue with, proceed to, proceed with
items.example: After a short break, we continued discussing the plan.

items.title: may + 动词与 if 条件从句
items.explanation: may suffer 表示可能发生；if 引导条件从句，说明产生这种可能结果的条件。一般事实或现实可能条件中，if 从句常用一般现在时。
items.source: A young man may suffer from the green-eyed monster if his girlfriend begins going out with someone else
items.example: You may feel nervous if you speak in public for the first time.

items.title: mean 后接宾语从句
items.explanation: mean 后可直接接省略 that 的宾语从句，说明某个标志、事实或行为所表示的含义。
items.source: A green light on a traffic signal means your car can continue on
items.example: A flashing light means you should slow down.

items.title: 分词短语的逻辑主语
items.explanation: 句首分词短语没有明写主语时，其动作的执行者通常必须与主句主语一致；否则容易形成悬垂修饰语。
items.source: After reviewing the safety report, officials have decided to proceed with the project next Monday.
items.example: After checking the map, we chose a different route.

items.title: 过去完成时表示过去参照点之前
items.explanation: had just arrived 表示“刚刚到达”发生在 used it to describe 这一过去行为之前；just 强调时间间隔很短。
items.source: Old-timers used it to describe a man who had just arrived from one of the big cities back east
items.example: They welcomed a traveler who had just arrived from Boston.

items.title: who 引导限定性定语从句
items.explanation: who had just arrived... 修饰 a man，用来说明这是怎样的一个人。
items.source: Old-timers used it to describe a man who had just arrived from one of the big cities back east
items.example: I spoke to a woman who had recently moved here.
